SELECT A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건대분류구분코드 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건중분류구분코드 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건소분류구분코드 */ A.INCDNT_TTL_NM AS INCDNT_TTL_NM, /* 사건제목명 */ A.INCDNT_OCRN_YMD AS INCDNT_OCRN_YMD, /* 사건발생일자 */ A.OCRN_RPT_YMD AS OCRN_RPT_YMD, /* 발생보고일자 */ A.INCDNT_CN AS INCDNT_CN, /* 사건내용 */ A.INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN AS INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN, /* 사건관련규모내용 */ A.PIC_NO AS PIC_NO, /* 담당자번호 */ A.INST_NO AS INST_NO, /* 기관번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(C.FLNM_ENCPT) AS PIC_NM, /* 담당자명 */ C.WRD_TELNO AS WRD_TELNO, /* 유선전화번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO, /* 휴대전화번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(C.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR, /* 이메일 */ D.CTPV_NM AS CTPV_NM, /* 시도명 */ D.SGG_NM AS SGG_NM, /* 시군구명 */ A.RM_CN AS RM_CN, /* 비고내용 */ A.ATFINO AS ATFINO, /* 첨부화일번호 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO, /* 긴급대응사건번호 */ (SELECT F.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO FROM ACA710 F WHERE F.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO AND ROWNUM < 2) AS EMRG_CNTRMS_ACTN_NO FROM ACA700 A, SAA000 B, SCA100 C, SAA020 D /* 통합기관(B), 종사자(C) 시군구코드(D), 긴급대응조치 (E) */ WHERE A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO(+) AND B.SGG_CD = D.SGG_CD(+) AND A.PIC_NO = C.ENFSN_NO AND A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}

/* saveData - Lee MS */
MERGE INTO ACA700 /* 긴급대응보고 */ USING DUAL ON (EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD}, /* 긴급대응사건대분류구분코드 */ EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD}, /* 긴급대응사건중분류구분코드 */ EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD}, /* 긴급대응사건소분류구분코드 */ INCDNT_TTL_NM = #{INCDNT_TTL_NM}, /* 사건제목명 */ INCDNT_OCRN_YMD = #{INCDNT_OCRN_YMD}, /* 사건발생일자 */ OCRN_RPT_YMD = #{OCRN_RPT_YMD}, /* 발생보고일자 */ INCDNT_CN = #{INCDNT_CN}, /* 사건내용 */ INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN = #{INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN}, /* 사건관련규모내용 */ PIC_NO = #{PIC_NO}, /* 담당자번호 */ INST_NO = #{INST_NO}, /* 기관번호 */ RM_CN = #{RM_CN}, /* 비고내용 */ ATFINO = #{ATFINO}, /* 첨부화일번호 */ LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID}, /* 최종수정자아이디 */ LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시 */ WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO, /* 긴급대응사건번호 */ EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건대분류구분코드 */ EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건중분류구분코드 */ EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건소분류구분코드 */ INCDNT_TTL_NM, /* 사건제목명 */ INCDNT_OCRN_YMD, /* 사건발생일자 */ OCRN_RPT_YMD, /* 발생보고일자 */ INCDNT_CN, /* 사건내용 */ INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN, /* 사건관련규모내용 */ PIC_NO, /* 담당자번호 */ INST_NO, /* 기관번호 */ RM_CN, /* 비고내용 */ ATFINO, /* 첨부화일번호 */ FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}, #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD}, #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD}, #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD}, #{INCDNT_TTL_NM}, #{INCDNT_OCRN_YMD}, #{OCRN_RPT_YMD}, #{INCDNT_CN}, #{INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN}, #{PIC_NO}, #{INST_NO}, #{RM_CN}, #{ATFINO}, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )

/* selectDtlById - Lee MS */
SELECT A.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO, /* 대상자정보번호 */ A.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO, A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO, C##RG.DEC_B64(C.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM, /* 대상자명 */ C.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD, /* 성별구분코드 */ C.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD, /* 대상자출생일자 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO, /* 긴급대응사건번호 */ A.INCDNT_NO_SN AS INCDNT_NO_SN, /* 사건번호일련번호 */ B.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD, B.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD, (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(G.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 G WHERE G.ENFSN_NO = D.CASE_PIC_NO) AS CASE_PIC_NM, (SELECT F.INST_NM FROM SAA000 F WHERE F.INST_NO = D.PIC_INST_NO) AS PIC_INST_NM FROM ACA701 A JOIN SEB100 B ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SEB150 D ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = D.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND D.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN SEA200 C ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO AND A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}

/* insertDtlData - Lee MS */
INSERT INTO ACA701 ( EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO, /* 긴급대응사건번호 */ INCDNT_NO_SN, /* 사건번호일련번호 */ TRPR_INFO_NO, /* 대상자정보번호 */ CASE_MNG_NO, CASE_MNG_ODRNO, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(INCDNT_NO_SN),0)+1 FROM ACA701 WHERE EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}), #{TRPR_INFO_NO}, #{CASE_MNG_NO}, #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )
